name: Small Inside Bar Strategy
summary: This EA trades the Inside Bar candlestick pattern, entering breakout trades when a smaller candle forms entirely within the range of the previous mother bar. It uses the high/low breakout of the inside bar as entry signals with stop loss placed beyond the mother bar extremes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于内包(Inside Bar)K线形态进行交易，当一根较小的K线完全包含在前一根母K线的范围内时，在内包K线的高低点突破处入场，止损设在母K线的极值之外。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是经典的内包形态(Inside Bar)突破交易法。入场条件：当前K线的高点低于前一根K线的高点且低点高于前一根K线的低点，即形成内包形态，随后价格突破内包K线的高点则做多，突破低点则做空。出场条件：止损设置在母K线（即前一根K线）的高点之上或低点之下，止盈通常为止损的倍数或基于固定点数目标。仓位管理方面，该EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于资金比例的仓位计算。资金管理相对简单，缺乏复杂的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的价格行为(Price Action)交易方法，依赖市场整理后的突破方向选择来获利。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on the classic Inside Bar breakout pattern from price action trading. Entry conditions require the current bar's high to be lower than the previous bar's high and its low to be higher than the previous bar's low, forming an inside bar; a buy is triggered when price breaks above the inside bar's high, and a sell when it breaks below the low. Exit conditions place stop loss beyond the mother bar's extremes (above the high for shorts, below the low for longs), with take profit set as a multiple of the stop loss distance or a fixed pip target. Position sizing typically uses a fixed lot size, though some versions may include percentage-based sizing. Money management is relatively straightforward without dynamic position adjustment. The overall logic is clean and represents a well-known price action methodology that profits from directional resolution after market consolidation.

parameters.description: 止损点数（基于母K线范围或固定值）
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in pips (based on mother bar range or fixed)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分不同实例的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number identifier for EA orders

parameters.name: MaxSpread
parameters.description: 最大允许点差，超过则不入场
parameters.description_en: Maximum allowed spread; no entry if exceeded

parameters.name: MinMotherBarPips
parameters.description: 母K线最小点数范围，过滤过小形态
parameters.description_en: Minimum mother bar pip range, filters small patterns

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典价格行为形态，易于理解和验证
内包形态代表市场整理，突破方向通常具有较高的动能延续性
止损基于母K线极值设置，具有逻辑合理性，风险收益比可控
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, based on a classic price action pattern that is easy to understand and verify
Inside bars represent market consolidation, and breakouts often carry strong momentum continuation
Stop loss placed beyond the mother bar extremes is logically sound with controllable risk-reward ratio
cons: 内包形态在震荡市中容易产生虚假突破导致频繁止损
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一周期信号可靠性有限
固定手数交易无法根据市场波动性动态调整仓位，资金利用率低
cons_en: Inside bar breakouts frequently produce false signals in ranging markets, leading to repeated stop losses
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, limiting signal reliability from a single timeframe perspective
Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust to market volatility, resulting in suboptimal capital utilization
improvements: 增加多时间框架过滤，如在大周期趋势方向上只交易同方向的内包突破
引入ATR动态止损止盈和仓位管理，适应不同市场波动环境
加入成交量或动量指标作为突破确认过滤器，减少虚假突破
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe filtering to only trade inside bar breakouts aligned with the higher timeframe trend
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss, take profit, and position sizing to adapt to varying market volatility
Incorporate volume or momentum indicators as breakout confirmation filters to reduce false breakouts

risk_points: 缺乏多时间框架确认可能导致逆趋势交易，增加亏损概率
震荡行情中虚假突破频繁，连续止损可能累积较大损失
risk_points_en: Lack of multi-timeframe confirmation may lead to counter-trend trades with increased loss probability
Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets can accumulate significant losses through consecutive stop hits
